description: Source code for plotting and visualization functions within BORIS, a behavioral observation software. Contains functions for creating behavior bar plots and event timeline plots based on observational data, interacting with database functions, and configuring plot appearance.

methods.name: default_value(ethogram, behavior, parameter)
methods.description: Calculates default value for behavior duration or point events, returning 'NA' for point events if applicable.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif( ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif, include_modifiers, parameters, )
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary structure for behaviors and their modifiers for selected subjects and parameters.

methods.name: dict init_behav(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behaviors, parameters)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary for behaviors per subject with default values.

methods.name: dict create_behaviors_bar_plot( pj: dict, selected_observations: list, param: dict, plot_directory: str, output_format: str, plot_colors: list = cfg.BEHAVIORS_PLOT_COLORS, )
methods.description: Creates a bar plot visualizing behavior durations and occurrence counts over a specified time interval, handling database queries and plot arrangements.

methods.name: create_events_plot( self, selected_observations, parameters, plot_colors=cfg.BEHAVIORS_PLOT_COLORS, plot_directory="", file_format="png", )
methods.description: Generates a timeline (Gantt-like) plot of behavior events per subject over time, supporting different time interval configurations and including behavior modifiers.
